about_the_game:
🐥 Chickout is a cooperative puzzle–platformer designed for 2–6 players. Become part of a team of adorable chicks and overcome challenging obstacles that require timing, coordination, and pure teamwork.

Whether you play online or locally, Chickout offers a hilarious and fun experience where communication is key. A single wrong move can bring the whole team down—but that’s the funny part!

Features:

  • 2-6 player co-op – Play online or on the same screen.

  • Easy to learn, hard to master – Simple controls, but teamwork makes it truly challenging.

  • Puzzle–platform gameplay – Unlock doors, solve puzzles, and progress together.

  • Chaotic fun – Laugh at the fails, celebrate the wins.

  • Cute and colorful design – Family-friendly, perfect for game nights.

Chickout brings you the madness of co-op gameplay—but this time with quirky little chicks!

Can your team hatch the perfect strategy and reach the finish?
